cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.text: Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't think they let me win the race, do you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They slowed near the end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because they couldn't maintain my pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then acknowledge my superior knot preparation.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You lost the chess game. The agreement says you wash up. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we were joking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You were very serious about my washing up while you were winning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we play again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the dishes. Call it a practical interval.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone having fun.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone having fun.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What do you gain if your cousin wins the club election?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A competent president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And which of your proposals becomes easier to approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The car park needs resurfacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I know which square of competence we're discussing.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why I've left a convenient space for your name.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Neither of us has been emotionally changed by the biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't need chess to change me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll enjoy discovering how much the kitchen matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you put your club captaincy on the rematch?

beats.speaker: B
